oneSentenceStory: Understand how to preserve your expiring points and redirect them safely toward your long-term goals.
customerSituation: Customer has 2,400 points expiring in 9 days while maintaining multiple long-horizon savings goals.
storyTension: Risk of losing accumulated value through inaction versus aversion to high-pressure, manipulative urgency tactics.
customerResolution: Clear, educational guidance on how to secure expiring points without forced immediate spending.
primaryOutcome: Restored confidence and protection of expiring rewards aligned with future security goals.
